'''2018 European MPC Results Erik Spijksma LS Yavin 4 Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Erik Spijksma]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Erik Spijksma]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
